name: textile-pos
description: Strictly typed POS system for textile retail shop

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.docker:restart: docker compose down && docker compose up --build
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec backend npx prisma db seed
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec backend npx prisma migrate deploy
